meta.description: ~$40M ARR Series C vertical SaaS for field-service & industrial operations. Synthetic dataset; all figures generated, not real.

metric_definitions.arr: Sum of account ARR for the period (rolled up live from the customers fact).
metric_definitions.nrr: Cohort Net Revenue Retention = (end-period ARR of accounts present at window start) / (their start ARR). Churned->0; expansion & contraction included; new logos excluded.
metric_definitions.grr: Cohort Gross Revenue Retention = (start ARR - contraction - churn) / start ARR. Expansion not credited (each account capped at its start ARR).
metric_definitions.magic_number: SaaS Magic Number = Net New ARR (quarter) / S&M spend (prior quarter).
metric_definitions.cac_payback_mo: Blended CAC Payback (months) = S&M (prior quarter) / (Gross New Bookings (quarter) x Gross Margin / 12). Gross New Bookings = sum of positive account ARR deltas (new logos + expansion).
metric_definitions.rule_of_40: Rule of 40 = YoY ARR growth% + operating-margin proxy%, where operating-margin proxy = (quarterly revenue - COGS - S&M) / quarterly revenue. NOTE: simplified proxy; this dataset carries no R&D/G&A.
metric_definitions.gross_margin: Gross Margin = 1 - COGS / quarterly revenue. Quarterly revenue approximated as period-end ARR / 4.
metric_definitions.win_rate: Win rate = won deals / (won + lost deals) for the segment-quarter.
metric_definitions.concentration_ent_share: Enterprise ARR share = Enterprise ARR / total ARR.
